scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:fake: concurrently -k -n fake,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "FAKE_API_KEY=local-fake-key npm run fake -w server" "SUNO_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7999 SUNO_API_KEY=local-fake-key SUNO_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=700 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
